items.name: 가시씨앗 심기
items.when: 가시씨앗 카드를 땅에 놓아 심을 때
items.prompt: Cozy fantasy game sound: a magic seed pressed into soft soil, quick earthy dig, then thorny vines sprouting and creaking upward with a soft magical shimmer

items.name: 가시 공격
items.when: 밤 전투 중 가시가 주변 적을 때리고 묶을 때(공격 주기마다 1번)
items.prompt: Thorny vine whip lashing and scratching an enemy, quick whoosh with prickly bramble scrape, fantasy game sound effect, short

items.name: 검은 털 봉헌
items.when: 검은 털을 바쳐 가시 방책이 완전히 자라고 강화될 때
items.prompt: Dark magical ritual: thorny vines rapidly growing and twisting, deep purple mystical swell with creaking wood, empowering fantasy game sound

items.name: 가시 방책 피격
items.prompt: Small impact on a thorny bramble bush, branches rustling and snapping lightly, short game hit sound

items.name: 가시 방책 소멸
items.prompt: Thorny vine bush withering and collapsing, dry branches cracking and crumbling into dust, fantasy game sound

items.name: 보물상자 열기
items.when: 보물상자 카드를 써서 상자가 열릴 때
items.prompt: Old wooden treasure chest opening: metal latch unlocking click, creaky hinge, then a small sparkling magical chime, fantasy game

items.name: 유물 획득
items.when: 물음표 카드 중 하나를 골라 유물을 얻을 때
items.prompt: Mystical relic obtained: warm shimmering magical chime with soft choir-like glow, fantasy game reward sound, gentle not loud

items.name: 낡은 마법서 펼치기
items.when: 낡은 마법서 카드로 고르기 창이 열릴 때
items.prompt: Old leather spellbook opening, heavy cover thump, pages fluttering, faint magical whisper sparkle, fantasy game sound

items.name: 토끼·사슴 도망
items.when: 마녀·적·용병이 가까이 와 야생동물이 달아날 때
items.prompt: Small forest animal (rabbit or deer) startled and fleeing through grass and leaves, quick rustle and light hoof patter, game sound

items.name: 토끼·사슴 쓰러짐
items.prompt: Small wild rabbit or deer hurt, short soft squeal yelp, cartoon game sound effect, not gory

items.name: 화살 명중
items.prompt: Wooden arrow thudding into a creature, sharp short thwack impact, fantasy game sound effect, no reverb

items.name: 생고기 먹기
items.when: 생고기 카드를 마녀에게 써서 체력을 채울 때(뒤이어 회복음)
items.prompt: Cartoon character eating a chunk of meat, two quick juicy bites and chewing, cozy game sound effect, short
